strings.database_path_help: Enter the full path to the SQLite file. Local files, UNC/LAN paths, and network shares or mounts reachable through a VPN are supported. The new path is used after restarting the application.
strings.database_restart_required: Settings saved. The new database path will be used on the next start.
strings.no_filter: No filter selected = full inventory. Data is grouped by brand in alphabetical order.
strings.no_inventory_rows: No items match the selected filters.
strings.beta_channel: Update channel: BETA (beta-latest), Flutter branch. BETA builds only receive other BETA builds.
strings.stable_channel: Update channel: STABLE, main branch. Stable builds only receive stable releases.
strings.dev_channel: Development build: update checks are available, OTA installation requires a published release.
strings.scanner_hint: The HID scanner works even without clicking this field
strings.no_customer: No customer linked · scan the health card / tax code
strings.ready_scanner: HID scanner ready. Scan a barcode/SKU or the customer tax code.
strings.sale_preparing: Sale in progress: stock will be deducted when you register the sale.
strings.name: Name
strings.translation_help: To add a language, copy an existing JSON file, change languageCode and languageName, and translate every value in the strings section. Press the refresh button next to the Language menu to reload the files.
strings.gift_card_purchase_help: The gift card will be added to the cart and linked to {customerName} when the sale is registered. The price paid is the gift card value.
strings.value_greater_than_zero: Enter a value greater than zero.
strings.gift_card_expiration_help: Set an expiration date or leave the gift card without expiration.
strings.no_gift_cards_customer: No gift cards are linked to this customer.
